1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.JunctionFan
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.GapKiteStep
3 
4 /-! The kite used by the planar inequalities is exactly the union of
5 the two actual triangle developments in their common junction chart. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Real Set Wedge
10 
11 namespace IncidentTriangles
12 
13 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
14     {u v : T.vertices} {edge : T.graph.Adj u v}
15     {chart : P.CutVoronoiChart a (T.vertexTarget u)} {θ : ℝ}
16 
17 /-- The two triangle images keep their distinct planar source copies. -/
18 def developedKite (D : IncidentTriangles T edge chart θ) : Set Plane :=
19   convexHull ℝ ({D.motion D.model.first, D.motion D.model.left, D.motion D.model.right} : Set Plane) ∪
20     convexHull ℝ ({D.motion D.model.second, D.motion D.model.left, D.motion D.model.right} : Set Plane)
21 
22 end IncidentTriangles
23 
24 namespace JunctionFan
25 
26 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} {T : P.CutLocusTree a}
27     {u : T.vertices} (fan : JunctionFan T u)
28 
29 /-- The actual two source labels are exactly the endpoints of the assigned gap. -/
30 theorem gap_source_pair
31     (m : circularGapMidpoints fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last)
32     {α β : ℝ} (gap : IsCircularGap fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last α β)
33     (midpoint : (m : ℝ) = (α + β) / 2) :
34     let D := fan.triangles m
35     ({D.motion D.model.first, D.motion D.model.second} : Set Plane) =
36       {fan.order.chart.origin + P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u) • direction α,
37         fan.order.chart.origin + P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u) • direction β} := by
38   dsimp only
39   let D := fan.triangles m
40   obtain ⟨ordered, width, _, _, first, second, empty_gap⟩ := circular_gap_spec
41     fan.order.sites fan.order.angles fan.order.increasing fan.order.bounds fan.order.chart.origin
42     (P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u)) fan.order.position fan.order.first fan.order.last
43     fan.order.at_first fan.order.at_last fan.order.two gap
44   have on_ray (ρ : ℝ) (hr : ρ ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) fan.order.radius) :
45       fan.order.chart.map (fan.order.chart.origin + ρ • direction ((α + β) / 2)) ∈
46         openSegment ℝ (T.vertexTarget u : Space) ((fan.order.neighbors m).val : Space) := by
47     rw [← midpoint]
48     exact fan.order.rays m ρ hr
49   have left := fan.order.chart.incident_branch_source T (fan.order.neighbors m).property rfl
50     D.first (fun t => (D.member t).1) D.first_label ordered width first second empty_gap
51     fan.order.radius_positive on_ray
52   have right := fan.order.chart.incident_branch_source T (fan.order.neighbors m).property rfl
53     D.second (fun t => (D.member t).2) D.second_label ordered width first second empty_gap
54     fan.order.radius_positive on_ray
55   have different : D.motion D.model.first ≠ D.motion D.model.second :=
56     D.motion.injective.ne D.model.distinct_sources
57   rcases left with l | l <;> rcases right with r | r
58   · exact (different (l.trans r.symm)).elim
59   · rw [l, r]
60   · rw [l, r, pair_comm]
61   · exact (different (l.trans r.symm)).elim
62 
63 /-- No surrogate kite is used: both full developed triangles form exactly this gap kite. -/
64 theorem developed_kite_eq
65     (m : circularGapMidpoints fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last)
66     {α β : ℝ} (gap : IsCircularGap fan.order.angles fan.order.first fan.order.last α β)
67     (midpoint : (m : ℝ) = (α + β) / 2) :
68     (fan.triangles m).developedKite = gapKite fan.order.chart.origin
69       (P.surfaceDist a (T.vertexTarget u))
70       (dist (u : Space) ((fan.order.neighbors m).val : Space)) α β := by
71   have pair := fan.gap_source_pair m gap midpoint
72   let z := fan.order.chart.origin
73   let y := z + dist (u : Space) ((fan.order.neighbors m).val : Space) • direction m
74   have union_pairs (p q : Plane) :
75       convexHull ℝ ({p, z, y} : Set Plane) ∪ convexHull ℝ ({q, z, y} : Set Plane) =
76         ⋃ s ∈ ({p, q} : Set Plane), convexHull ℝ ({s, z, y} : Set Plane) := by simp
77   unfold IncidentTriangles.developedKite
78   rw [(fan.triangles m).at_junction, (fan.triangles m).at_neighbor]
79   change convexHull ℝ ({_, z, y} : Set Plane) ∪ convexHull ℝ ({_, z, y} : Set Plane) = _
80   rw [union_pairs, pair, ← union_pairs]
81   dsimp [z, y]
82   rw [midpoint]
83   unfold gapKite
84   rw [union_comm]
85   apply congrArg₂ (fun A B : Set Plane => A ∪ B)
86   · apply congrArg (convexHull ℝ)
87     ext x
88     simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
89     tauto
90   · apply congrArg (convexHull ℝ)
91     ext x
92     simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
93     tauto
94 
95 end JunctionFan
96 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
